title: Berberine and Weight Loss: What You Need To Know
publisher: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NIH)
text:
Some studies suggest that it might, but the evidence is not conclusive.

Many of the studies included in this review had a high risk of bias, and the outcomes of individual studies were inconsistent. Therefore, additional, high-quality research would be needed to allow definite conclusions to be reached about whether berberine reduces weight and BMI.
